name: Spolous II
storyline:
A century ago, the pilot Akleon used the space fighter Estaprick to defeat Doscopian forces and liberate the mysterious ore, spolous, which could be used to create unlimited energy. For a time, there was peace... but now, a new threat has emerged.

Deadly fields, known as Spot Voids, are appearing and swallowing worlds. Researchers discovered Spot Voids could be eliminated by raw spolous ore, increasing the demand for spolous more than ever, and a giant radar was built to locate resources for extraction.

Soon, the once-scattered Doscopians returned in overwhelming numbers, led by Colonel Ankreda Milt. Doscopian forces constructed a new fortress, the Srid Saina, to prevent Danioy forces from accessing much-needed spolous.

Once again, the space fighter Estaprick was readied for battle, this time piloted by Akelon's descendant, Cyan Varen. Now, with the future of the Danioy Galaxy at stake, the Estaprick sets out to put an end to the Doscopian threat...
summary: This is a side-scrolling 2.5D shooting game.By collecting capsules (items) that appear throughout the stages, the gauge displayed at the bottom of the screen will fill up.Once the gauge is filled, you can power up your ship by pressing the power-up button.
